page.overview:
What is Ghostbusters?

Dimensions (2016) BrickHeadz (2018) Icons (2020)

Ghostbusters is a theme based on Ghostbusters. There was originally just the Ideas set 21108 Ghostbusters Ecto-1, but eventually LEGO produced their own set based on the franchise.
